capabilities: Edit code files with syntax highlighting, folding, and find & replace
Reveal and manage hidden dotfiles and extensionless files in the explorer
Preview HTML, SVG, Mermaid, JSON, CSV, and diff files beside code
Review Git diffs, keep or revert hunks, and commit individual files
Chat with AI agents and APIs about notes and code in a sidebar
extras: Git, Ask AI, and adding external folders by symlink are desktop-only; file management and code editing also work on mobile and tablets. The manifest notes the plugin has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff. Installation via BRAT is supported for pre-release builds; the README includes a privacy and network disclosure section.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer hides dotfiles and extensionless files, and its editor is not built for code files, so developers must leave the app to work on scripts and configs.

relations.evidence: Use Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, and other coding agents with their workspace tools.
Connect Ollama, Atomic Chat, LM Studio, CC Switch, or another compatible server.

requires.name: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen, or other API provider
Coding CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot) or local model servers (Ollama, LM Studio)

summary: Turns Obsidian into a code and file workspace: edit 170+ file types, reveal dotfiles, preview HTML and data, review Git diffs, and chat with AI agents.
